description: Parcel-level Lead Hazard Data is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center. This dataset contains data pertaining to parcel lead risk. These data were generated primarily for use in Parcels N'at. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-10-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
